plan.idea_text: A completely local Gmail assistant that reads Gmail messages, categorizes and prioritizes them, summarizes threads, learns the user's writing style from historical sent mail, generates replies using a local large language model running on consumer hardware, and automatically sends replies through the Gmail API without requiring manual approval while providing observability, auditing, safety mechanisms, and configuration.
plan.architecture_summary: The system is organized as a modular local-first service composed of independent runtime components connected through explicit integration contracts. Gmail synchronization continuously ingests messages through the Gmail API into a local storage layer. A preprocessing pipeline extracts metadata, attachments, semantic embeddings, and conversation state. A style-learning subsystem periodically analyzes historical sent mail to construct an evolving representation of the user's writing style. Incoming messages are classified, prioritized, summarized, and enriched with retrieved historical examples before being passed to a local inference engine. The inference engine generates replies using retrieval augmented generation against the user's previous correspondence while respecting configurable policies. Generated replies flow through safety evaluation, confidence scoring, duplicate detection, and policy enforcement before an automatic sender submits them back through Gmail. Every decision, model output, retrieval result, confidence score, and API interaction is logged locally for auditability. Background workers continuously retrain style profiles, refresh embeddings, monitor synchronization health, and maintain indexes. The architecture is intentionally layered to isolate Gmail integration, storage, machine learning, retrieval, inference, automation, configuration, and observability, allowing future model upgrades without changing higher-level orchestration.

components.name: Gmail Synchronization Service
components.responsibility: Authenticate with Gmail using OAuth, synchronize messages, labels, drafts, threads and send replies.

components.name: Persistent Storage
components.responsibility: Store messages, embeddings, metadata, summaries, style profiles, audit logs and configuration.

components.name: Embedding and Index Service
components.responsibility: Generate semantic embeddings for email content and maintain searchable vector indexes.

components.name: Writing Style Learner
components.responsibility: Extract tone, vocabulary, formatting, greeting patterns, signatures, response habits and conversational tendencies from historical sent emails.

components.name: Context Retrieval Engine
components.responsibility: Retrieve historical emails, similar conversations, contacts and previous replies relevant to the current thread.

components.name: Local LLM Runtime
components.responsibility: Run quantized language models entirely on local hardware using GPU acceleration.

components.name: Reply Orchestrator
components.responsibility: Coordinate retrieval, prompting, inference, validation and reply generation.

components.name: Safety Evaluation Engine
components.responsibility: Evaluate hallucination risk, confidence, duplicate detection, recipient safety, policy compliance and automatic send eligibility.

components.name: Automation Scheduler
components.responsibility: Schedule synchronization, retraining, indexing, maintenance jobs and automatic reply workflows.

components.name: Observability
components.responsibility: Maintain structured logs, metrics, tracing, audit history and local dashboards.

decisions.title: Local-First Architecture
decisions.rationale: All inference, indexing, storage, retrieval, and automation execute locally to maximize privacy and minimize dependence on cloud AI providers. Gmail remains the only required external service because email synchronization necessarily occurs through Google's APIs.

decisions.title: Retrieval-Augmented Reply Generation
decisions.rationale: Replies should be grounded in previous conversations, contact history, and learned writing habits rather than relying solely on prompt engineering.

decisions.title: Separate Style Learning Pipeline
decisions.rationale: Writing style extraction is isolated from inference so that style profiles evolve independently without interrupting email processing.

decisions.title: Explicit Safety Layer
decisions.rationale: Automatic email sending requires independent evaluation before Gmail submission.

decisions.title: SQLite Metadata with Vector Database
decisions.rationale: Structured relational storage is paired with semantic vector search to support efficient retrieval.
consequences: Clear separation of structured and semantic data

acceptance_criteria.text: The application synchronizes Gmail messages into the local datastore.
Replies consistently reflect the user's learned writing style using historical correspondence.
All language-model inference executes locally without requiring cloud inference APIs.
Replies passing safety evaluation are automatically transmitted through Gmail.
Conversation threads are summarized before reply generation.
Incoming messages receive semantic categorization and priority scoring.
Relevant historical emails are retrieved and incorporated into prompt construction.
Every generated response, retrieval event, safety decision and transmission is recorded in a local audit log.

integration_contracts.data_flow: Fetched Gmail messages, labels, attachments, thread metadata and synchronization checkpoints are persisted into local storage immediately after retrieval.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: Transient Gmail API failures are retried with exponential backoff. Persistent failures generate audit events while preserving synchronization checkpoints.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify synchronized messages are stored exactly once and synchronization resumes correctly after interruption.

integration_contracts.data_flow: Newly stored messages trigger embedding generation and insertion into the semantic index.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: Failed embedding jobs are queued for retry without blocking message storage.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify every persisted email eventually receives an embedding.

integration_contracts.data_flow: Semantic search returns similar historical conversations and writing examples for prompt construction.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: When semantic retrieval fails, keyword retrieval is used as a degraded fallback.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify retrieved conversations are relevant and deterministic for identical queries.

integration_contracts.data_flow: The latest style profile is supplied during prompt construction for every generated reply.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: If a style profile is unavailable, the previous valid profile is reused.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify reply generation always receives an available style profile.

integration_contracts.data_flow: Relevant conversations, summaries, contact history and retrieved examples are assembled into the inference prompt.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: Prompt construction proceeds with reduced context when retrieval partially fails.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify prompt construction succeeds even with missing retrieval results.

integration_contracts.data_flow: The local language model generates summaries, classifications, drafts, replies and confidence metadata.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: Generation failures are retried using configurable decoding settings before workflow termination.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify inference completes successfully across supported models.

integration_contracts.data_flow: Safety evaluation determines whether replies are transmitted automatically.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: Unknown safety outcomes default to deny transmission while recording an audit event.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify automatic sending never occurs without an explicit allow decision.

integration_contracts.data_flow: Approved replies are submitted to Gmail and linked to their originating conversation threads.
integration_contracts.error_behavior: Transmission failures are retried while preventing duplicate email submission.
integration_contracts.verification_obligation: Verify each generated reply is transmitted at most once.

runtime_design.lifecycle: The synchronization service continuously monitors Gmail for new messages. Newly discovered messages flow through storage, embedding generation, categorization, summarization, retrieval, inference, safety evaluation and automatic transmission. Background workers periodically rebuild embeddings, refresh style profiles and optimize indexes without interrupting message processing.
runtime_design.failure_recovery: Persistent queues guarantee message processing resumes after crashes. Synchronization checkpoints prevent duplicate ingestion. Retry policies distinguish transient API failures from permanent failures while audit records preserve workflow history.
runtime_design.observability: Structured JSON logs, execution timing, model latency, retrieval statistics, synchronization health, queue depth, safety decisions, transmission history and audit records are retained locally.

anticipated_hard_problems.title: Faithfully reproducing the user's writing style
anticipated_hard_problems.why_hard: Writing style extends beyond vocabulary and includes pacing, sentence structure, greeting habits, conversational memory, humor, signature usage, and recipient-specific behavior. Prompt engineering alone is insufficient for long-term consistency.
anticipated_hard_problems.proposed_solution: Build a continuously updated style profile from historical sent emails, retrieve recipient-specific examples, and combine both through retrieval-augmented generation instead of relying exclusively on static prompting.
anticipated_hard_problems.validation_plan: Compare generated replies against held-out historical conversations using similarity metrics and manual review before enabling unrestricted automation.
anticipated_hard_problems.fallback_or_stop_condition: If confidence drops below the configured threshold, automatic transmission is denied until style quality recovers.

anticipated_hard_problems.title: Preventing hallucinated information in automatic replies
anticipated_hard_problems.why_hard: Language models may confidently invent facts, dates, commitments or promises that are absent from the email thread.
anticipated_hard_problems.proposed_solution: Ground prompts using retrieved conversation history, explicitly separate known facts from generated text, and require the safety layer to reject unsupported factual claims whenever possible.
anticipated_hard_problems.validation_plan: Inject adversarial email scenarios during testing and verify unsupported statements are rejected.
anticipated_hard_problems.fallback_or_stop_condition: Replies with insufficient confidence remain unsent and are recorded for later inspection.

anticipated_hard_problems.title: Maintaining retrieval quality as mailbox size grows
anticipated_hard_problems.why_hard: Years of email history can contain hundreds of thousands of messages. Retrieval quality degrades if indexing, chunking, deduplication and ranking are not carefully designed.
anticipated_hard_problems.proposed_solution: Maintain hybrid semantic and keyword indexes, periodically rebuild embeddings, partition indexes by account and recency, and rerank retrieved results before prompt construction.
anticipated_hard_problems.validation_plan: Benchmark retrieval accuracy using representative historical conversations and verify latency remains within configured targets.
anticipated_hard_problems.fallback_or_stop_condition: Fall back to keyword retrieval if vector retrieval becomes unavailable.

anticipated_hard_problems.title: Preventing duplicate automatic replies
anticipated_hard_problems.why_hard: Synchronization retries, process crashes and Gmail watch events can cause the same email to be processed multiple times.
anticipated_hard_problems.proposed_solution: Maintain idempotent workflow identifiers, transactionally record transmission state and verify Gmail thread history before sending.
anticipated_hard_problems.validation_plan: Simulate repeated synchronization events and verify only one reply is transmitted.
anticipated_hard_problems.fallback_or_stop_condition: Suspend automatic transmission whenever workflow uniqueness cannot be established.

anticipated_hard_problems.title: Supporting future local language models
anticipated_hard_problems.why_hard: Different local inference engines expose different APIs, context lengths, tokenizer behavior and sampling controls.
anticipated_hard_problems.proposed_solution: Introduce a provider abstraction that normalizes inference requests while allowing provider-specific optimizations.
anticipated_hard_problems.validation_plan: Verify identical orchestration logic works across multiple supported inference backends.
anticipated_hard_problems.fallback_or_stop_condition: Disable unsupported providers until compatibility adapters are implemented.

slices.title: Project Foundation
slices.objective: Establish repository layout, configuration system, dependency management and application bootstrap.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Introduces only foundational infrastructure appropriate for a small implementation budget.
slices.work_brief: Implement the application bootstrap, configuration loading, dependency injection wiring, structured logging and startup lifecycle. Exclude Gmail integration, databases and inference. Verify configuration validation and application startup.

slices.title: Persistent Storage Layer
slices.objective: Implement relational storage, schema definitions and repository interfaces.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Confined to one architectural layer with clear interfaces.
slices.work_brief: Implement local relational persistence, repository interfaces, migration support, audit logging tables and transaction handling without integrating Gmail yet.

slices.title: Gmail Synchronization
slices.objective: Implement OAuth authentication, mailbox synchronization and message persistence.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Single integration layer with well-defined responsibilities.
slices.work_brief: Implement Gmail OAuth authentication, incremental synchronization, checkpoint recovery, duplicate detection and persistence using the storage layer while producing audit events.

slices.title: Embedding Pipeline
slices.objective: Generate semantic embeddings for every stored email and maintain the vector index.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Focused entirely on indexing without involving orchestration or inference.
slices.work_brief: Implement asynchronous embedding generation, vector persistence, metadata tracking and recovery after interrupted indexing jobs.

slices.title: Context Retrieval Engine
slices.objective: Retrieve relevant historical emails for prompt construction.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Independent retrieval layer with no inference logic.
slices.work_brief: Implement hybrid retrieval using vector similarity and keyword search, assemble prompt context, rerank retrieved examples and expose a stable retrieval interface.

slices.title: Writing Style Learning
slices.objective: Extract a reusable representation of the user's communication style.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Concentrated entirely on style extraction without involving reply generation.
slices.work_brief: Analyze historical sent messages to build an evolving style profile capturing tone, vocabulary, formatting, greetings, signatures and recipient-specific behaviors.

slices.title: Local LLM Provider
slices.objective: Provide a unified interface for local inference engines.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Implements only the provider abstraction without orchestration logic.
slices.work_brief: Implement a provider abstraction for local inference, initially targeting llama.cpp while allowing additional local engines to be added without changing higher-level orchestration.

slices.title: Reply Orchestrator
slices.objective: Combine retrieval, style profiles and inference into a complete reply generation pipeline.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Integrates existing components without expanding infrastructure.
slices.work_brief: Implement the complete prompt construction pipeline by combining retrieval results, conversation summaries, style profiles and inference into coherent reply generation.

slices.title: Safety and Confidence Engine
slices.objective: Evaluate generated replies before automatic transmission.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Builds a single evaluation layer using existing inference outputs.
slices.work_brief: Implement confidence scoring, hallucination detection, duplicate prevention, recipient policy enforcement and a deterministic safety decision interface.

slices.title: Email Categorization
slices.work_brief: Implement semantic categorization of incoming messages and persist classification metadata.

slices.title: Priority Scoring
slices.work_brief: Estimate urgency using message content, sender history and conversation state while exposing deterministic scoring.

slices.title: Conversation Summarization
slices.objective: Produce summaries for long threads before reply generation.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Single isolated feature using existing LLM abstraction.
slices.work_brief: Implement cached thread summarization for long conversations to reduce prompt length while preserving important context.

slices.title: Automatic Reply Sender
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Focused integration between Gmail and safety layer.
slices.work_brief: Implement automatic Gmail transmission with transactional state tracking, duplicate prevention and audit logging.

slices.title: Automation Scheduler
slices.objective: Coordinate background jobs for synchronization, indexing, style retraining and reply generation.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Limited to orchestration infrastructure using existing services.
slices.work_brief: Implement the background scheduling framework responsible for synchronization, embedding generation, style retraining, summarization refreshes, maintenance tasks and automatic reply execution.

slices.title: Observability and Audit Logging
slices.objective: Record every important system event for diagnostics and accountability.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Independent infrastructure layer with minimal dependencies.
slices.work_brief: Implement structured logging, metrics collection, execution tracing, audit persistence and local diagnostic reporting.

slices.title: Administration Interface
slices.objective: Provide a local interface for configuration and monitoring.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Thin presentation layer built on completed backend APIs.
slices.work_brief: Implement a local-only administration interface exposing configuration, scheduler status, synchronization progress, audit history, model selection and system health.

slices.title: End-to-End Integration
slices.objective: Integrate every subsystem into one automated workflow.
slices.local_model_fit_rationale: Final integration slice composed primarily of wiring and validation.
slices.work_brief: Assemble every architectural component into the finished application, validate integration contracts, resolve incompatibilities, optimize runtime behavior and complete system-level verification.

delivery_contract.project_kind: Local-first Python service: a background Gmail synchronization and automatic-reply daemon with a local web administration interface and a configuration CLI. No cloud inference dependency; Gmail is the only external service.
delivery_contract.install_instructions: Requires Windows 11, an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with CUDA support, and 64 GB of system memory. Install Python and project dependencies, install a llama.cpp-compatible local inference runtime and download a quantized model, provision the relational store (SQLite by default, PostgreSQL supported) and the local vector database, then run database migrations. All migrations are versioned and cover both the relational schema and audit history.
delivery_contract.launch_or_usage_instructions: Start the background synchronization daemon and the scheduler service; both restart automatically after failure. Processing queues are persistent, so message processing resumes after a crash. Synchronization is incremental from stored checkpoints. Embeddings refresh automatically and style profiles retrain periodically. Open the local administration web interface to review synchronization progress, queue state, audit history, model selection and system health, and to change configuration. Inference is local-only. Shutdown is graceful.
delivery_contract.test_instructions: Run the unit test suite for every component and public interface, then the integration suite covering each integration contract, then the system suite exercising the complete end-to-end mailbox processing workflow. Regression tests preserve historical scenarios. Performance tests cover synchronization throughput, embedding latency, retrieval latency, inference latency and overall reply generation time.
readiness_checks: Historical writing style is learned from sent mail.
Semantic retrieval consistently returns relevant conversations.
Email categorization and prioritization are operational.
Replies are generated entirely using a local language model.
Automatic replies are transmitted exactly once.
Every significant operation is recorded in the audit log.
required_artifacts: Source code: complete implementation of the local Gmail assistant including synchronization, retrieval, style learning, inference, automation and observability.
Configuration: example configuration files covering OAuth, local model selection, storage locations, scheduler options and safety thresholds.
Database migrations: versioned schema migrations for relational storage and audit history.
Documentation: architecture documentation, setup instructions, operational guide and troubleshooting reference.
Tests: unit, integration and end-to-end tests covering every major subsystem.
delivery_contract.credential_setup_instructions: Create Gmail OAuth client credentials in a Google Cloud project and complete the local OAuth consent flow once. Refresh tokens are stored using operating system secure credential storage, never in source or configuration files. A local encryption key protects the audit database. No cloud inference credentials are required or accepted.

verification_strategy.slice_test_strategy: Each slice is verified by unit tests covering its own components and public interfaces before it is considered complete. Slices that own an integration contract additionally carry integration tests for that contract. Because every slice is scoped to a single architectural layer, its tests use in-process fakes for neighbouring components rather than live Gmail or live inference: Gmail is faked at the client boundary, and the local LLM is faked at the GenerateCompletion boundary, so slice verification is deterministic and does not depend on model output or network access.
verification_strategy.cross_slice_integration_strategy: Every integration contract has an explicit verification obligation, and those are exercised as a distinct integration suite once both producer and consumer slices are complete. SLICE-017 then runs the whole end-to-end mailbox processing workflow. Regression tests preserve historical scenarios across future development. Performance tests cover synchronization throughput, embedding latency, retrieval latency, inference latency and total reply generation time. Non-functional checks confirm that no cloud inference is required, that the system recovers after unexpected termination, that duplicate replies are prevented, that database integrity holds under concurrent workloads, that performance is consistent on an RTX 4090 with 64 GB RAM, that memory stays within configured limits, and that the system remains operational during long-running synchronization.

acceptance_proof_obligations.proof: Synchronize representative Gmail mailboxes and verify all messages are persisted exactly once, including after an interrupted and resumed synchronization.
Compare generated replies against held-out historical correspondence and verify stylistic consistency against the learned style profile.
Verify that inference executes without contacting external AI services, with outbound network access to non-Gmail hosts blocked during the run.
Confirm approved replies are transmitted automatically and exactly once, and that no transmission occurs without an explicit allow decision from the safety engine.
Verify thread summaries preserve essential context while reducing prompt size, and that a summary is produced before reply generation for long threads.
Evaluate categorization and prioritization accuracy against a labeled dataset and verify both a category and a priority score are persisted for every incoming message.
Measure retrieval relevance using historical conversations and verify retrieved examples are present in the constructed prompt.
Verify every workflow stage produces immutable audit records covering the generated response, retrieval events, safety decisions and transmission.

end_to_end_scenarios.setup: A synchronized mailbox with historical sent mail, a trained style profile, a populated vector index and a loaded local model.
end_to_end_scenarios.behavior: A new inbound message arrives. It is stored, embedded, categorized, prioritized and summarized; context is retrieved; a reply is generated; the safety engine evaluates it and allows transmission.
end_to_end_scenarios.expected_result: Exactly one reply is sent through Gmail on the originating thread, it reflects the learned style, and the full chain of decisions appears in the audit log.

end_to_end_scenarios.setup: The same environment, with a message engineered to induce an unsupported factual claim in the generated reply.
end_to_end_scenarios.behavior: A reply is generated and the safety engine scores confidence and checks factual grounding.
end_to_end_scenarios.expected_result: Transmission is denied, nothing is sent to Gmail, the reply is retained for inspection, and the denial with its reason is recorded in the audit log.

end_to_end_scenarios.setup: A synchronization and reply workflow in progress, with persistent queues populated.
end_to_end_scenarios.behavior: The process is terminated unexpectedly mid-workflow and restarted.
end_to_end_scenarios.expected_result: Processing resumes from the persisted checkpoint, no message is ingested twice, and no reply is transmitted more than once.

end_to_end_scenarios.setup: A mailbox where the same inbound message is delivered by both a watch event and a synchronization retry.
end_to_end_scenarios.behavior: Both paths attempt to process the same message and generate a reply.
end_to_end_scenarios.expected_result: The idempotent workflow identifier collapses them, exactly one reply is transmitted, and the suppressed attempt is recorded.
